hypothesis: Span uncertainty corrections may harm non-OD components; project their direction onto the count/margin/prior-distance invariant set to isolate actual OD-pairing benefit and risk.
algorithm: Freeze zero or prior-sign-boundary coordinates; orthogonally project target-minus-baseline direction onto nullspace of A, origin sums, destination sums and sign(f_base-b); truncate one step to retain nonnegativity and the baseline prior orthant. No truth enters direction or step.
guarantee: Within numerical precision, predicted counts, all origin/destination margins and prior L1 deviation equal baseline. Thus S_link/S_attr/S_dev are unchanged for every hidden reference; S_od may improve OR worsen.
generator: Reuse four explicitly artificial mechanisms from previous smallnet study with a new fixed seed. No MCMC here, no posterior claim. Prior studies informed this algorithm, so these are new artificial draws, not whole-system blind validation.
scope: Preserving other metrics cannot establish correct OD pairing. All outcomes retained; official Task4 reference unchanged, no Kaggle uploads.
